text: Binary per-row measure from the OP's "argument" text only (current supplied text, including marked edits; edits not removed, no timing inferred): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, recounts at least one direct personal anecdote, meaning a specific experience, event or situation they personally lived or directly witnessed (e.g., "when I worked at...", "my friend told me / happened to me"). 0 if the text has only abstract claims, general statistics, hypotheticals/invented scenarios, or other people's experiences or quotations not adopted as the OP's own direct experience; quotation marks alone neither make nor break an anecdote. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed (never evidence); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an anecdote or outcome text by itself and may be retained if relevant. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.
